leadText:
Linda (Japanese: リンダ Linda) is a character of the day who appeared in The Mighty Accelguard to the Rescue!. She is a childhood friend of Charles and is well aware he is in fact the Mighty Accelguard.

Linda stopped a lone thief with her after the Mighty Accelguard failed to do so because of his clumsiness. Later, she picked up a few leads about the trucks seen in the area and went to the Cold Storage alone to investigate. There, she was confronted by Dr. Ferrara and his henchmen, and captured.

She was later saved by Charles, who was assisted by and . When Ferrara made his escape, Linda followed behind Mighty Accelguard in a truck with Ash and his friends while she contacted Officer Jenny. She also helped stop Ferrara's henchmen and their Vanillite.

Linda enjoys teasing Charles about his clumsiness.
